items.title: Simple Spawns Flower Town
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Welcome to Flower Town! A cute little town covered in… well… flowers! But these aren’t just any little plants though. The ground here is so rich your regular backyard poppy has grown to immense size. Making this place vibrant and full of color.

-Create your own adventure in this beautiful town.
-A welcoming environment for the weary traveler.
-Bring your friends along.

items.title: Simple Spawns Jungle Ruins
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
You are a castaway who's landed on a lush green jungle island. Venture through this uncharted territory and find the resources to survive!

+ Comfy villages built into the treetops.
+ Old abandoned temples and ruins to investigate.
+ Ancient hidden treasures and ample resources!

items.title: Luxury Modern Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Summer is approaching and it's time to go show off some luxury modern fashion! You've got style and you've got money so look the part with some rich clothing. Strut around the city like you own it, and enjoy spending some quality time with your friends!

- 12 skins
- Modern designs
- Great for roleplay

items.title: Parkour Pros
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Are you a parkour pro? Whether you are or just love jumping around your Minecraft world, this athletic skin pack is perfect for you! Get your headbands on your sneakers ready for some big jumps because it's parkour time!

- 12 skins
- Modern designs for teens
- Colorful options

items.title: Pets World
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Collect, tame, carry, and customize! Pets World adds 27 NEW PETS with a very unique feature on where you can carry your own pet! Shower, feed, play and help them sleep after a long day! 

+ 27 cute pets!
+ 10 fashionable accessories!
+ Custom sounds per pet!
+ Unique interactions and features!
+ Super cute custom textures!
+ Includes a city to explore!

items.title: Magical Forest II
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
"I hear birds chirping and twittering, singing a song. This makes me wonder about birds and where their songs come from. How ancient the song I am hearing really is. As I take a step into the forest, I notice at first the trees, stretching high above the ground."

-Stunning survival spawn
-By RareLoot

items.title: Secret Mountain Base
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
This secret base looks insignificant from the outside. But deep inside, research is being conducted on new, secret technologies that must be protected at all costs. 

- Secret research base with rocket launchpad
- Big mountain range
- Can you find all the hidden chests?
- By Team Ethyria

items.title: Freebooters Cove
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Aye aye captain! Hop aboard and set sail to Freebooters Cove the home and refuge of history’s most legendary pirates. Live your best pirate life on this beautiful island!

- Pirate island survival spawn
- By Rareloot

items.title: Masked Hacker Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Cyberspace is your playground! Outsmart even the most advanced security system and hack into the mainframe! Get a coolness boost with this skin-pack and complete your digital vigilante look!

- 8 Teen skins
- By Rareloot

items.title: Royal Mobs
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
With a crown and sceptre in hand these monsters rule the night, nether and end realms! Unleash your minions on unsuspecting Minecraft players in these royally-frightening skins!

- 12 Noble monster skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Anime Starter Pack
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
You want to get started in the anime universe of Minecraft? No problem! This skinpack allows every player to feel like one of the included 12 unique characters.

- 12 Skins
- By Geniely

items.title: Color Block Teens
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Green, blue, yellow, or purple. Don't let blocks get in your way of being the best color.

items.title: Neko Cuties
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Meow? Everything is better with cats, but even better when they're cute.

items.title: Fantasy Realm
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Find your best robes, crowns, necklaces and dragon. It's time for high fantasy.

items.title: Demon Mobs
items.creator: Box Build
items.description:
Dress up as a wickedly fashionable creature with many unique styles to choose from on your adventures to have fun-filled adventures with your friends.

+ There are 13 mobs with different styles to choose from.
+ Created by Kuboc Studios.

items.title: Cartoon Anime Teens
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Do you love Anime? The cutest anime teens are here and waiting for you! Everyone will admire your cuteness and they won't be able to take their eyes off you!

+ 12 cute Anime skins
+ 2 FREE skins included!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Modern Streetwear
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Modern streetwear has all sorts of fresh new styles! Show off these cool new styles to all your friends!

-11 skins 
-Modern Styles

items.title: PrestonPlayz Neon Merch
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
Shine bright with PrestonPlayz’ neon merch skins! Pick from 14 vibrant designs. Featuring new merch designs like stacked and splattered flame. Brighten up your style with this pack today!

- 1 Preston skin
- 14 total skins

By PrestonPlayz & CinemaCraft

items.title: Rainbow Parkour
items.creator: Tetrascape
items.description:
Parkour with special effects in a fun and sleek map!
Created by Tetrascape

items.title: Trend Mobs Style
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Now mobs clothes are trending, are you ready to be the most fashionable person among your friends?

+11 skins
by UnderBlocks

items.title: Mob Artists
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
If you love arts and crafts than these artist themed mobs are for you! Each with their own design perfect for any scenario. Want to be an art teacher? Maybe a street artist? How about just messing around with colors? Well we got you covered. Enjoy these skins!

- 30 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Demon Teens
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Play with your friend and join the dark side of the world. Be a demon teen and start doom for a new world.

+ 10 demon teens
+ Roleplay

Created by Mine-North and Shape Studio

items.title: Dream Castle
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Do you ever want to have your very own dream castle and crown yourself king or queen? Take all your friends with you as you conquer the many rooms. Walk around the beautiful garden and market or feel the magic as you fly around with your own unicorn! 

- Roleplay 
- Giant castle 
- Ride flying unicorns 

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Epic Mobs
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Mobs have taken over the fashion scene! Get ready for a new trend set among creepers, zombies, spiders, and even slimes! Dress as your favorite mob while enjoying free time with your friends. Fill your backpacks with candy and explore the wonders of this new Minecraft skin pack. Good luck!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Team Visionary
